lines.zh: 我不走，我只是慢慢漂过去。
lines.en: I don't walk; I drift slowly over.
My vast shadow slides across the valley.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在云里拖出一条线。
lines.en: My tail trails a line through the clouds.
An inch of my movement dims the mountain.
Wind bears me up; I need no effort.
I turn around the pillar, very slowly.

lines.zh: 地面上的草被我的影子压弯。
lines.en: The grass below bends under my shadow.

lines.zh: 我飘到那美克星的天边。
lines.en: I drift to the edge of Namek's sky.
As I pass, the clouds part.
I lower my head to glance below.
I cross the sky slowly.
My scales shine green in the light.
I hang in the air without moving.
I wait for the wisher to speak.
My breathing raises a wind.
Three wishes remain.
I look around, slowly.
The sky here is quiet.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴盘在一座山上。
lines.en: I coil my tail around a mountain.
My eyes are like two green suns.

lines.zh: 我这样漂着，等上几天也行。
lines.en: I can drift like this for days.
Wind passes between my scales.

lines.zh: 我想起很久以前的许愿者。
lines.en: I recall wishers from long ago.

lines.zh: 我低下巨大的头，歇一歇。
lines.en: I lower my enormous head to rest.
The sky is my seat.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像一座雕像。
lines.en: I hold still, like a statue.
Little thing, you have woken me.
Gather all seven and you may speak.
You stand before me like a grain of sand.
I can hear your voice.
Three wishes. Not one more.
I see greed in your eyes.
I see your hands tremble.
Think carefully before you speak.
I am the dragon of Namek's balls.

lines.zh: 我低下头，让声音传得远些。
lines.en: I lower my head so my voice carries.
Is there another behind you?
I am waiting for one sentence.
This pain is like a mosquito bite.

lines.zh: 我的鳞上留下一道白痕。
lines.en: A white mark is left on my scales.
I swing my head slowly aside.

lines.zh: 这不算什么，可我不喜欢。
lines.en: It's nothing, but I dislike it.
My breath deepens and the wind changes.
My body sways once.
So small, and yet so strong.
I draw back a little, and the mountain groans.
I'll remember this.
No more; I dislike pain.
No food moves me.

lines.zh: 你把龙珠举起来，我看见了。
lines.en: You raise the dragon balls; I see them.
I know that light.

lines.zh: 你的愿望，比食物有意思。
lines.en: Your wish is more interesting than food.
I bend near, and the wind presses down.

lines.zh: 你想让我多留一会儿吗。
lines.en: Would you have me stay a while longer?

lines.zh: 我对着你的方向，慢慢眨眼。
lines.en: I blink slowly toward you.
Speak; I'm listening.
What you hold is warm.
My claws touch only dragon balls.

lines.zh: 你撞在我的鳞上，滑了下去。
lines.en: You hit my scales and slide down.
I shift aside gently so as not to crush you.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴扫过，风把你推开。
lines.en: My tail sweeps past and the wind pushes you.
You stand by my claw, so small.
I lower myself to make room.
That touch I barely felt.

lines.zh: 你被我的呼吸吹得后退。
lines.en: My breath pushes you back.

lines.zh: 我把爪子收起来，免得割到你。
lines.en: I draw in my claws so they don't cut you.

lines.zh: 你贴着我，像贴着一堵墙。
lines.en: You press against me like a wall.
I move aside slowly, and the ground shakes.
Another dragon comes out of the clouds.
We coil on either side of the mountain.
Its scales are deep green.

lines.zh: 我们不说话，只是并排悬着。
lines.en: We say nothing, only hang side by side.

lines.zh: 我们的呼吸合成一阵风。
lines.en: Our breathing becomes one wind.
This dragon is older than I.

lines.zh: 我们一起守着这几颗珠子。
lines.en: Together we guard these balls.
Clouds hide us both.
Long ago, a dragon kept me company.
Only two shadows remain at the sky's edge.

lines.zh: 我用爪子夹起那颗珠子。
lines.en: I pinch up the ball with a claw.

lines.zh: 这么小的东西，我差点看不见。
lines.en: So small I nearly missed it.

lines.zh: 我把它托在掌心，看了很久。
lines.en: I hold it in my palm and study it.
This light is familiar.
I set the ball back where it was.
I take nothing from mortals.
One touch and it rolls away.
This dragon ball returns to your hand.
In my hand it is like a speck of dust.
I keep it for the next summoning.
You'd strike? Think it through.
I don't fight, but I remember.
You cannot move me.
You strike before wishing.
My eyes turn to you, slowly.
I rise, and the sky darkens.

lines.zh: 你这一击，我记在愿望里。
lines.en: I will count this blow among your wishes.

lines.zh: 你确定要惹一条神龙吗。
lines.en: Are you sure you'd provoke a divine dragon?
I set a claw on the mountaintop.
You have one chance left to speak.

lines.zh: 我不还手，不代表我不在意。
lines.en: Not striking back doesn't mean I don't care.
Little one below, look up.
My shadow covers you now.

lines.zh: 我等着你的下一个动作。
lines.en: I wait for your next move.

lines.zh: 我的双眼始终落在你身上。
lines.en: My eyes rest on you without pause.
Three wishes — speak clearly.
I don't chase; you can't escape.

lines.zh: 这颗星球上没有第二个你。
lines.en: There is no second you on this world.
My breath is above your head.
Will you wish, or will you fight?
The clouds turn with me.
I lower my head slowly.

lines.zh: 你的气很小，可我看得见。
lines.en: Your ki is small, but I see it.

lines.zh: 三个愿望，我数着心跳等。
lines.en: Three wishes — I count heartbeats till then.
The sky is mine; the ground is yours.
Look up and you'll see me.
I'm patient; this night is long.
Come a little closer, then.
I tilt my head to listen.

lines.zh: 我不出手，只是把爪子放下。
lines.en: I don't strike; I only set my claw down.

lines.zh: 我的身体擦过山，石头崩了。
lines.en: My body scrapes the mountain and rock falls.

lines.zh: 你被我的动作带倒在地。
lines.en: My movement knocks you down.

lines.zh: 我无意伤你，可你太近了。
lines.en: I don't mean to hurt you, but you're too near.
My tail shifts once.

lines.zh: 三个愿望，你只说了两个。
lines.en: Three wishes, and you've spoken two.

lines.zh: 我低头，气息喷在你身上。
lines.en: I lower my head and my breath washes over you.

lines.zh: 这一点点力气，不算攻击。
lines.en: This little strength of mine is no attack.
You're pushed back a few steps.
I pull my claw back; you're unharmed.

lines.zh: 地裂了一道，不是我故意的。
lines.en: The ground cracked; not on purpose.
I'd rather you didn't come closer.

lines.zh: 我的重量本身就是警告。
lines.en: My weight alone is a warning.
Stand still; I'll make room.

lines.zh: 七颗珠子亮了，我从光里出来。
lines.en: Seven balls glow, and I come out of the light.
A seam opens in the sky.
I descend from above the clouds.
The land darkens first.
Namek's wind stops.
Someone has spoken the summoning words.

lines.zh: 我的头先穿出云，然后是身体。
lines.en: My head parts the clouds, then my body.
A pillar of light shoots skyward.

lines.zh: 山脉在我的影子下变小。
lines.en: The mountains shrink under my shadow.
I have come to grant three wishes.

lines.zh: 我从很远的地方被唤来。
lines.en: I was called here from very far.
Thunder rolls, and I arrive.
The balls scatter, and I take form.
The color of the sky changes.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴从云里抽出来。
lines.en: I pull my tail out of the clouds.
I look down at this world.

lines.zh: 火在我鳞上散开，像落叶。
lines.en: Fire scatters off my scales like leaves.

lines.zh: 我从空中跌了一点，随即稳住。
lines.en: I drop a little, then steady myself.
Water does nothing to me; it's only cold.

lines.zh: 爆风把我身边的云推开了。
lines.en: The blast scatters the clouds around me.

lines.zh: 一枚小东西弹在我的胸口。
lines.en: A small thing bounces off my chest.

lines.zh: 这法术绕着我，像一层雾。
lines.en: That spell wraps me like a fog.
I don't eat, and I'm not hungry.

lines.zh: 雷落在我身上，我抬了抬头。
lines.en: Lightning strikes me, and I lift my head.
The void would swallow me; it's too shallow.
